# 판정: 기호주의 검증 draft (대표 지시 발동) — 에이 편집용 hst_AAA §5.2 lem:doeblin 의 Claim 5·6·7·8·Assembly proof 를 한글 + 화살표 골격(⟹/⟺)으로. 최종본 아님(승인 후 산문화 대상).
---

*기호주의 모드(대표 지시). 함의·근거를 전부 화살표(⟹/⟺) 골격으로 노출 — 떠있는 assertion·gap 이 한눈에 보이게. 산문화는 검증·승인 후.*

기호(Claim 1~4에서): 낙하벡터 $\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL}$, fall map $\mathbf{A}^{\sharp}$·유사역 $(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}$·커널기저 $\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}$, fall shift $\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}$, 자유좌표 $\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$, per-block 밀도 $f$, Jacobian $J$, compact target $\mathsf{K}$, chamber $\mathsf{U}$, 상태 $s^{\star}\in\mathsf{C}_0$.

## Claim 5 (slice floor)

**진술.** $\mathbf{k}\in\mathsf{K}$ ⟹ $\bigl|\mathsf{Fibre}(\mathbf{k})\bigr|_{\mathrm{Leb}} \ge m_0 := \dfrac{b^{nL}(b^{1-n}/2)^L(2r)^{(n-1)(L-1)}}{J}$.
단 $\mathsf{Fibre}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}) := \{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp} : (\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL}\}$.

**증명 (목표: $|\mathsf{Fibre}(\mathbf{k})|\ge m_0$).**

$$
\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\sim\mathrm{Unif}([0,b]^{nL}),\ \mathbf{a}^{\sharp}:=\mathbf{A}^{\sharp}\mathbf{b}^{\sharp};\quad \forall \mathsf{B}\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{n-1}:
$$
$$
\mathbb{P}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{B}) \overset{\text{Claim 2(II)},\,\mathsf{S}=\mathbb{R}^{nL}}{=\!=\!=} b^{-nL}J\!\int_{\mathsf{B}}\!|\mathsf{Fibre}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp})|\,d\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}
$$
$$
\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}=\mathring{\mathbf{b}}^{\sharp}_1+\cdots+\mathring{\mathbf{b}}^{\sharp}_L\ (\text{iid},\ \text{밀도}\,f) \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{밀도}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp})=f^{\ast L} \;\Longrightarrow\; \mathbb{P}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{B})=\int_{\mathsf{B}}f^{\ast L}
$$
$$
\text{두 식}\ \forall\mathsf{B} \;\Longleftrightarrow\; f^{\ast L}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp})=b^{-nL}J\,|\mathsf{Fibre}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp})| \;\Longrightarrow\; |\mathsf{Fibre}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp})|=\tfrac{b^{nL}}{J}f^{\ast L}(\mathbf{a}^{\sharp})\quad(\forall\mathbf{a}^{\sharp})
$$
$$
\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}=\mathbf{k}\ +\ \text{Claim 4}\,(f^{\ast L}(\mathbf{k})\ge (b^{1-n}/2)^L(2r)^{(n-1)(L-1)}\ \text{on}\ \mathsf{K}) \;\Longrightarrow\; |\mathsf{Fibre}(\mathbf{k})|=\tfrac{b^{nL}}{J}f^{\ast L}(\mathbf{k})\ge m_0>0.\ \blacksquare
$$

## Claim 6 (비교의 퇴화 / 측도 bound)

**진술.** 비교 $\mathsf{A}=\{a=(i,j,\rho)\}$, 계수 $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\in\{0,\pm1\}^{nL}$ (열린 $v_i$-낙하 $+1$·$v_j$-낙하 $-1$), gap $=\Delta_{ij}(\mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star}))+\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\cdot\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}$. 비퇴화 $\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}:=\{a:(\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\ne\mathbf{0}\}$, $\kappa_{\mathsf{U}}:=\min_{i\ne j}\inf_{\mathbf{u}\in\overline{\mathsf{U}}}|\Delta_{ij}(\mathbf{u})|$. 아래 (I)(II)(III).

**(I) 퇴화 dichotomy.** (목표: 퇴화 ⟹ $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a=\mathbf{0}$ 또는 final-equality; 후자 tie 탈출.)

$$
(\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a=\mathbf{0} \;\Longleftrightarrow\; \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\perp\ker\mathbf{A}^{\sharp} \;\Longleftrightarrow\; \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\in\operatorname{Range}((\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{\top})=\{\text{노드그룹 상수},\ \text{그룹합}=0\}
$$
$$
\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\ (\text{$v_i$군}\in\{0,+1\},\ \text{$v_j$군}\in\{0,-1\}) + \text{그룹상수} \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{각 노드 all-or-none}
$$
$$
+\ \text{그룹합}=0 \;\Longrightarrow\; \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a=\mathbf{0}\ (\text{아무 낙하 X, 결정론})\ \ \text{또는}\ \ \text{final-equality}\ \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\cdot\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}=\textstyle\sum_\ell b^{\sharp}_{i,\ell}-\sum_\ell b^{\sharp}_{j,\ell}
$$
$$
\text{final-equality: } \Delta_{ij}(\mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star}))+\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\cdot\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}=\Delta_{ij}(\mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star})+\mathbf{A}^{\sharp}\mathbf{b}^{\sharp})=\Delta_{ij}(\mathbf{u}) \;\Longrightarrow\; |\cdot|\ge\kappa_{\mathsf{U}}\ (\ast).\ \blacksquare
$$

**(II) tie-tube 측도.** (목표: $\bigl|\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL},\ \min_{a\in\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}}|\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\cdot\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}+\Delta_{ij}(\mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star}))|\le\delta\}\bigr|\le C_{\mathrm{tie}}\delta$.)

$$
\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}\ \text{유한} \;\Longrightarrow\; \lambda_\ast:=\min_{a\in\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}}\|(\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\|>0
$$
$$
\text{비교}=\text{$\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$의 아핀},\ \text{기울기}=(\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a,\ \|\cdot\|\ge\lambda_\ast \;\Longrightarrow\; \{|\cdot|\le\delta\}=\text{slice좌표 길이}\le 2\delta/\lambda_\ast
$$
$$
\text{각 slice 지름}\le b\sqrt{nL}\ (\because \|\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}-\mathbf{z}^{\sharp\prime}\|=\|\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}(\cdot)\|\in[-b,b]^{nL}) \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{유계단면 적분}+\text{유한합}\le C_{\mathrm{tie}}\delta.\ \blacksquare
$$

**(III) 경계 측도.** (목표: $\bigl|\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL},\ \min_j b^{\sharp}_j\le\delta\ \text{or}\ \min_j(b-b^{\sharp}_j)\le\delta\}\bigr|\le C_{\mathrm{bdry}}\delta$.)

$$
\text{면 }\{b^{\sharp}_j=0/b\}:\ \text{아핀 } \mathbf{e}_j\cdot((\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}),\ \text{기울기}\ (\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\mathbf{e}_j\ne\mathbf{0}\ (\because \text{아니면 } \mathbf{e}_j\in\operatorname{Range}((\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{\top})\ \text{모순 (I)})
$$
$$
\;\Longrightarrow\; \text{같은 slicing},\ 2nL\ \text{면} \;\Longrightarrow\; \le C_{\mathrm{bdry}}\delta.\ \blacksquare
$$

## Claim 7 (robust core)

**진술.** $\delta>0,\ (C_{\mathrm{tie}}+C_{\mathrm{bdry}})\delta\le m_0/2,\ \delta\le\kappa_{\mathsf{U}}$ ⟹ $\bigl|\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{k}+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{R}_\delta(s^{\star})\}\bigr|\ge m_\ast:=m_0/2$.

**증명.**

$$
\text{전체 slice floor} = m_0\ [\text{Claim 5}] \;;\; \text{도려낸 tube(tie+경계)}\le(C_{\mathrm{tie}}+C_{\mathrm{bdry}})\delta\le m_0/2\ [\text{Claim 6(II)(III)}]
$$
$$
\;\Longrightarrow\; m_0-m_0/2=m_0/2=:m_\ast\ \text{잔존 in}\ \mathsf{R}_\delta(s^{\star})
$$
$$
\text{$\mathsf{R}_\delta$ 위 모든 비교 확정 부호}\ (\text{비퇴화}=\delta\text{-margin},\ \text{퇴화}=\text{Claim 6(I)}) \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{부호가 itinerary 결정} \;\Longrightarrow\; \mathsf{R}_\delta=\textstyle\bigsqcup_{\amalg}\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}.\ \blacksquare
$$

## Claim 8 (transport)

**진술.** $\mathbf{b}^{\flat}\in[0,\varepsilon]^{nLT_{\max}},\ \mathbf{u}\in\mathsf{U},\ \amalg$ ⟹ $\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}(\mathbf{u}-\mathring{\mathbf{h}})+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}\}$의 모든 $\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$가 shift 후에도 $[0,b]^{nL}$·branch $\amalg$ 유지.

**증명 (5단계 (A)~(E)).**

- **(A) Setup.** 단일 Lipschitz $\Gamma<\infty$ bounds $\{\|\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat}\|,\ \|(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat}\|,\ \text{비교의 }\mathbf{b}^{\flat}\text{-감도}\}\le\Gamma\varepsilon$; $\varepsilon\le\min\{b/(8nT_{\max}),\ \delta/(4\Gamma),\ \kappa_{\mathsf{U}}/(4\Gamma)\}$.
- **(B) 좌표 불변.** $\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\mapsto\widehat{\mathbf{b}}^{\sharp}:=\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}-(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat}$ ⟹ $\mathbf{A}^{\sharp}\widehat{\mathbf{b}}^{\sharp}=\mathbf{u}-\mathring{\mathbf{h}}-\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat}$; (†) 좌표로 **$\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$ 불변** (target 만 이동).
- **(C) 크기 bound.** $\mathsf{R}_\delta$ 위 비퇴화 $\ge\delta$ from tie ⟹ tie 없음·단일 branch $\amalg$. shift $\le\Gamma\varepsilon\le\delta/4$ ⟹ 비퇴화 $\le\delta/2$ 이동·부호 유지; 퇴화 final-equality $\ge\kappa_{\mathsf{U}}/2$ [Claim 6(I)].
- **(D) Hence.** 부호 유지 ⟹ $\widehat{\mathbf{b}}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL}$·branch $\amalg$ 유지.
- **(E) slice 측도 보존.** ∀$\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$ in slice ⟹ shift target 에서도 branch-$\amalg$ deposit set slice 측도 $\ge$ 원래, uniform in $\mathbf{b}^{\flat}$. $\ \blacksquare$

## Assembly

**목표.** $(P^{\star})^{nL}(s^{\star},\mathsf{B}\times\{v_n\})\ge\eta\,|\mathsf{B}|/|\mathsf{U}|$ ⟹ $\mathsf{C}_0$ small.

$$
\text{endpoint} = \text{terminal fall time}\ (X_{t_{r+nL}}=v_n,\ \text{no subsequent flow});\quad \mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star})\longmapsto\mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star})+\mathbf{A}^{\sharp}\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}+\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat}
$$

favourable scenario: cyclic falls (terminal $v_n$) + branch $\amalg$ with $\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}$ + 모든 non-fall $\le\varepsilon$ ⟹ walker $\to v_n$, 높이$\in\mathsf{B}$ ⟺ good event $\mathsf{G}_{\mathsf{B}}$.

$$
\text{이산 floor}: \mu_{\min}^{nL}\,(\text{cyclic schedule})\cdot(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}\,(\text{branch pick})
$$
$$
\rho_{\mathbf{b}^{\flat}}(\mathbf{u})=\tfrac{J}{b^{nL}}\sum_{\amalg}\bigl|\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}(\mathbf{u}-\mathring{\mathbf{h}}-\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat})+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}\}\bigr| \overset{\text{Claim 7,8}}{\ge} m_\ast J/b^{nL}=:c_\ast>0\ \text{on}\ \mathsf{U}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
(P^{\star})^{nL}(s^{\star},\mathsf{B}\times\{v_n\})
&\ge \mu_{\min}^{nL}(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}\!\int_{[0,\varepsilon]^{nLT_{\max}}}\! b^{-nLT_{\max}}\!\int_{\mathsf{B}}\rho_{\mathbf{b}^{\flat}}(\mathbf{u})\,d\mathbf{u}\,d\mathbf{b}^{\flat} &&(\because\mathsf{G}_{\mathsf{B}})\\
&\ge \mu_{\min}^{nL}(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}(\varepsilon/b)^{nLT_{\max}}c_\ast|\mathsf{B}| &&(\because\rho\ge c_\ast,\ \int\mathbf{b}^{\flat})\\
&= \eta\,|\mathsf{B}|/|\mathsf{U}| &&(\eta:=\mu_{\min}^{nL}(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}(\varepsilon/b)^{nLT_{\max}}c_\ast|\mathsf{U}|>0)
\end{aligned}
$$
$$
\;\Longrightarrow\; (P^{\star})^{nL}(s^{\star},\cdot)\ge\eta\,\nu,\ \ \nu=\mathrm{Unif}(\mathsf{U})\otimes\delta_{v_n} \;\Longrightarrow\; \mathsf{C}_0\ \text{small}.\ \blacksquare
$$

**Snowfall A 필수.** 각 낙하 Lebesgue 밀도 ⟹ fall density floor. Snowfall B ⟹ 라운드 상수 ⟹ $nL$ 좌표가 라운드당 스칼라로 붕괴 ⟹ image Lebesgue-null in $\mathbb{R}^{n-1}$ ⟹ floor 실패.
